items.title: Stock Radar: Balkrishna Industries stock breaks out from falling parallel channel; time to buy the stock which is in bear grip?
items.description: Balkrishna Industries Ltd has recently broken out from a falling parallel channel, indicating potential recovery. The stock has found support in the Rs 1,900 to 2,000 range three times since June. Analysts suggest buying the stock with a target above Rs 2,400 within the next few months. A successful retest of the breakout line as support would confirm a change of trend.

items.title: Sensex, Nifty turn lower; broader markets crash as oil tops $116/barrel. What lies ahead?
items.description: Indian equities turned lower as crude oil prices crossed $116 per barrel, raising concerns about inflation and economic growth. While the Sensex and Nifty posted modest declines, midcap and smallcap indices fell more sharply amid weak market breadth.

items.title: Q2 earnings upgrades hold above 50%, says Jefferies. Is the profit cycle turning?
items.description: India’s Q2 FY27 earnings show signs of resilience, with Jefferies reporting that 50% of the 105 companies it tracks received FY27 earnings estimate upgrades, while 41% saw downgrades and 9% remained unchanged. The share of companies beating expectations rose to 56% from 52% in the previous quarter, though the recovery remains uneven across sectors.

items.title: Ashish Kacholia Q2 portfolio: Ace investor adds 3 new stocks, increases stake in 2 companies. Own any?
items.description: Ace investor Ashish Kacholia, popularly known as the 'Big Whale', has made a series of changes to his Rs 3,000 crore portfolio, according to Trendlyne, in the second quarter of financial year 2027. Ashish Kacholia is among India's most closely watched veteran investors, with his portfolio activity regularly drawing the attention of retail and institutional investors. His investment decisions are widely tracked as indicators of emerging opportunities and changing market sentiment. Here’s what he bought in Q2.

items.title: ITC, RIL, HDFC Bank among top laggards as Nifty falls over 12% in 2026: Time to buy beaten-down stocks or wait for a recovery?
items.description: In 2026, the Nifty 50 index faced significant drops, with 34 out of 50 stocks plummeting by as much as 34%. Analysts believe that the sell-off is driven by foreign institutional investor exits and a conservative outlook on earnings. This decline presents potential opportunities for long-term investors as valuations dip below historical norms.

items.title: Q2 results impact: 2 Vedanta stocks rally up to 14% after Sept quarter earnings. How have they performed since demerger?
items.description: Shares of Vedanta Power and Vedanta Oil and Gas rallied up to 14% after both demerged companies reported a sharp year-on-year improvement in Q2 FY27 earnings. Vedanta Power returned to profit, while Vedanta Oil and Gas reported higher revenue and EBITDA.

items.title: Laurus Labs shares climb 4% after Q2 profit zooms 126% YoY
items.description: Laurus Labs shares rose 3.79% to Rs 2,329 after the pharmaceutical company reported strong Q2FY27 results. Revenue increased 33% year-on-year to Rs 2,206 crore, while net profit more than doubled to Rs 441 crore. Growth was supported by sustained momentum in its CDMO business and Affordable Medicines division, alongside improving margins and continued investments in manufacturing capabilities.

items.title: Jio Platforms share price up 28% from IPO price. Here’s what these 4 brokerages are saying
items.description: Jio Platforms shares extended their post-listing rally, rising over 28% in three sessions. Nomura, Motilal Oswal, Dolat Capital and Elara Capital remain positive, citing tariff hikes, 5G monetisation, broadband expansion and digital services growth.

items.title: IndiGo shares rise 2% after Q2 losses narrow. What are Jefferies and other brokerages saying?
items.description: IndiGo shares gained 2% after the airline reported a narrower year-on-year Q2 loss of Rs 1,879 crore, although profitability remained under pressure from elevated fuel costs and rupee depreciation. Jefferies retained its Buy rating but cut its target price to Rs 5,650, while Nuvama maintained its Buy call with a revised target of Rs 5,435.

items.title: Nifty rout hides a striking bull run: Smallcap universe gives 60 multibaggers since last Diwali
items.description: The stock market in India has encountered a rough patch, evidenced by the Nifty's decline of over 11% since last Diwali. However, smallcap stocks have emerged as stars, with 60 multibagger stocks tripling investors' money; Sterlite Technologies notably climbed 649.7%. Investors are cautioned to consider valuations seriously while pinpointing companies with significant growth potential for smarter investment decisions.

items.title: Diwali blues: 83 largecap stocks plunge up to 60% since Samvat 2082. Can bluechips light up D-Street in the new year?
items.description: Indian equities enter Samvat 2083 after a volatile year and a sharp market correction. While lower valuations have improved the risk-reward profile of several stocks, persistent FII outflows, elevated crude oil prices and global uncertainties remain key concerns. Strong domestic fundamentals and earnings growth could support markets, but returns will increasingly depend on stock selection, valuations and earnings delivery.

items.title: Reliance Industries shares down 26% in 2026: Here’s how to trade RIL stocks on results day
items.description: Reliance Industries has faced a notable drop in its shares by 26% throughout 2026. Investors and analysts are eagerly awaiting the upcoming results announcement. Past quarterly results have evoked varied responses, leading to fluctuations in stock value. Important technical thresholds to keep an eye on include Rs 1,130 acting as a support level and Rs 1,230 identified as a breakout benchmark.

items.title: Trent shares soar 7% after Q2 results. Here’s why Elara Capital, Nuvama remain bullish on the Tata stock
items.description: Trent shares rallied after the retailer reported 25% year-on-year growth in Q2 FY27 profit and a 21.9% rise in revenue. Elara Capital upgraded the stock to Buy, while Nuvama maintained its positive stance and Systematix retained Hold.

items.title: Core4 Engineers SME shares to list today: Check IPO subscription status and other key details
items.description: Core4 Engineers will make its debut on the BSE SME platform on October 30 after its Rs 54.82 crore IPO was subscribed 5.44 times. The NII category led demand with 12.26 times subscription, followed by QIBs at 5.06 times and individual investors at 2.72 times. The IPO was entirely a fresh issue of 58.94 lakh shares.

items.title: Suzlon Energy shares fall 4% as Nuvama, others slash target prices after Q2 margins disappoint. What lies ahead?
items.description: Suzlon Energy shares fell after the company reported a 69% year-on-year decline in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 394 crore, despite a 26% rise in revenue driven by record wind turbine deliveries. Nuvama said profit and EBITDA missed estimates. The profit decline was largely due to a high base in the year-ago quarter, when Suzlon recognised a one-time deferred tax asset benefit of Rs 891 crore.

items.title: Asian Paints shares see target price cuts by Jefferies, Goldman Sachs, other brokerages after Q2 results. Buy, sell or hold?
items.description: Asian Paints has reported a year-on-year profit growth of 7% for the second quarter of FY 2027. Revenue surged by around 17%, although expenses climbed by 19%, underscoring the challenges posed by inflation. Despite brokerages adjusting their target prices, the company declared an interim dividend of Rs 5.75 per share and hinted at upcoming price hikes.

items.title: Hero MotoCorp among 4 stocks that closed below VWAP
items.description: On October 29, the closing prices of four stocks from the Nifty 500 pack fell more than 1% below their respective VWAPs (Volume Weighted Average Prices), according to StockEdge’s technical scan data. VWAP represents the average price at which a stock traded during the day, weighted by trading volume. A closing price below VWAP indicates that the stock ended the session below its volume-weighted average traded price.

items.title: 8 midcap stocks with over 100% profit growth in Q2FY27
items.description: High year-on-year (YoY) growth in quarterly net profit indicates a significant improvement in a company's profitability compared with the corresponding quarter last year. Based on the latest September 2026 quarter results announced so far, data from StockEdge's profitability scan shows that, among NSE Midcap companies, the top 8 recorded more than 100% YoY growth in quarterly net profit in Q2FY27.

items.title: Market wrap:  Shriram Finance, Nestle India, Trent, InterGlobe top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Friday
items.description: The Nifty 50 rose 0.51% to close at 23,053.10 on Friday, while the Sensex gained 308 points to 74,459.53. Trent and InterGlobe led the gainers, while Shriram Finance and Nestle India topped the Nifty losers. Broader markets remained weak, with midcap and smallcap indices falling up to 2%.

items.title: Sebi issues final order against Axis Capital, imposes regulatory censure; Axis Bank shares fall over 1%
items.description: SEBI has issued a regulatory censure against Axis Capital, concluding proceedings linked to September 2024 restrictions. The regulator noted no recorded investor harm or fraudulent default, while Axis Bank expects no material business impact.

items.title: Sensex rises 308 points, Nifty above 23,000 even as broader markets crash. Will D-Street bulls extend recovery next week?
items.description: Indian market indices Sensex and Nifty ended the week on a high note, each climbing by up to 0.5%. Even as the broader market suffered losses, standout performers like Trent and IndiGo flourished thanks to positive earnings. The Nifty IT index was a highlight, soaring over 2%, while Nifty Consumer Durables fell nearly 2%.

items.title: FIIs hold $717 billion worth of Indian stocks, but trim exposure across 56% of Nifty 500 companies.  Where are they investing?
items.description: FIIs held $717 billion worth of Nifty 500 stocks in September 2026, with private banks accounting for the largest share of their investments. While foreign investors increased exposure to sectors such as healthcare, technology and automobiles, they trimmed holdings in 56% of Nifty 500 companies over the past year.

items.title: Varun Beverages shares fall over 4% as Q3 margin pressure weighs despite a 33% YoY revenue growth
items.description: Varun Beverages reported strong Q3 CY2026 revenue, profit and volume growth, but its shares fell as higher packaging costs weighed on margins. EBITDA margin declined 140 basis points year-on-year, while the company announced an interim dividend of Rs 0.50 per share.

items.title: Coal India shares fall 3% after Q2 results; Jefferies, Motilal Oswal, others cut target price
items.description: Coal India shares fell 3% despite a 57% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 6,547 crore. Jefferies and JM Financial cut their target prices to Rs 460 and Rs 438, respectively, while Motilal Oswal retained its Buy rating with a Rs 450 target, citing a potential volume recovery.

items.title: Explained: Why AI giants Google, Amazon, Intel shares crashed up to 23% in a single day
items.description: Shares of Alphabet, Amazon and Intel plunged on Thursday as investors fretted over rising AI spending, weakening cash flows and a subdued outlook. Alphabet shares fell over 13% after its Q3 results missed Wall Street estimates, with slowing search advertising growth and higher AI investments weighing on sentiment.

items.title: Equitas SFB shares tumble 27% in 2 days on CEO exit. More pain ahead?
items.description: Equitas Small Finance Bank shares plunged 27% in two sessions after CEO and founder PN Vasudevan announced his resignation over a perceived conflict involving his daughter’s NBFC.
